senses.gloss: (v. אֵיזֶה = b. h. אֵיפוֹא, אֵפֹה, אֵפוֹ) now, then, pray.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 30b:10">Yoma 30ᵇ</cite> <he>אודו לי א׳</he> (miss. in Mss., Ms. M. 2 <he>זי</he>) admit then at least.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 70a:2">B. Mets. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>אימא לי איזו</he> tell me now; a. e. V. <cite ref="E00347"><he>הֵידֵין</he></cite>.
